record.body:
## Description

R3: acceptance freeze fields test_ids and oracle_hashes.
R4: project:oracle-amendment type.

## Approach

Edit contract/project-design.json only (copy into .artifacts and resolve is Landing/execute hygiene).

1. On project:acceptance: add test_ids and oracle_hashes to payload; mark both optional_payload (present = oracle-backed). Document shape in a short comment in the contract purpose or in skill examples later: test_ids = comma-separated pytest node ids; oracle_hashes = comma-separated relpath:sha256:<hex> for files those ids live in.
2. Add project:oracle-amendment: pattern claim (or event if that fits other amendments better — prefer claim with status enum like backlog-item); purpose = approved change to frozen oracle; payload acceptance, effort, phase, old_hashes, new_hashes, status; payload_enum status requested|approved|rejected; payload_references acceptance→project:acceptance, phase→project:phase; required_sections Reason, Change.
3. Do not edit skills or close_batch here. Sibling oracle-skills / consistency tests will lock examples.
4. Verify: python3 -c import json; load contract; assert fields and type exist. Optional: pytest -q -k oracle_contract if you add a tiny contract-shape test under tests/ — only if it does not collide with skill consistency ownership.
